source: Branded beers, ciders, spirits, liqueurs, wines and ready-to-drink cocktails, from official brand and brand-owner nutrition pages (Heineken, Desperados, Birra Moretti, Strongbow, Guinness, Carlsberg Britvic, Peroni, Baileys, Bacardi Limited incl. Malta listings, Pernod Ricard, Brown-Forman, White Claw UK). Per 100 ml; alcohol in grams = % ABV x 0.789.

items.name: Heineken Original Lager
items.notes: Per 100 ml as published on the global Heineken site (176 kJ / 42 kcal). ABV 5% as stated on the same page; alcohol = 5 x 0.789. Salt published as <0.01 g, recorded as 0. Gluten from barley (page lists barley, hops and water).

gaps.name: Corona Extra (and Corona Cero)
gaps.reason: No official per-100 ml energy found. The UK Budweiser Brewing Group brand page gives no nutrition or ABV; corona.com and corona.de show no nutrition; tapintoyourbeer.com lists only US products per serving.

gaps.name: Stella Artois (and 0.0, Unfiltered)
